cultural.vision_reason: A patched brown cotton hide-like mask with cowrie-shell-edged eyeholes, fur trim, and bone/leather toggles — this matches the known Senufo type of textile "bogolan"-style ritual mask worn in Poro society ceremonies, plausible for Mali.

physical.title: mask
physical.summary:
Mask; textile; made of cotton dyed brown. Woven in vertical bands with evidence of patching on front and back using brown cotton thread. Front and back sewn together at seams using running stitch; patched using running stitch. Wooden pole running through stitched sleeve at top of mask.  Fur attached along full width of the mask at the top.   
Front has two eye holes edged with cowrie shells; one toggle made of bone and leather attached using leather thong; another leather thong; four patches.
Back has two toggles made of bone and leather attached with leather thongs; two toggles made of cotton and bone attached using cotton; decorative cotton tassels (?); two patches.
